name: ACLP Annual Meeting 2026 (CLP 2026)
description: The annual meeting of the ACLP, the academy for psychiatrists who care for medically ill patients. The 2026 theme is Expanding the Vision of C L Psychiatry: New Roles, New Settings, New Pathways.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission deadline (all formats)
deadlines.note: Submissions closed. A February 24, 2026 webinar covered the submission process.

sources.note: Confirms November 18 to 21, 2026, Town and Country Resort, San Diego, theme, and submission deadline of April 1.
Registration open; meeting hub at https://aclp.societyconference.com/ (content loads via script and could not be read).

notes: Registration early bird deadline not found. CLP 2027 dates and location are not published; ACLP has named a 2027 Annual Meeting Committee chair (Michael Marcangelo, MD). The 2027 abstract deadline will probably again fall around April 1, 2027 based on the 2026 pattern.
